memories.content: The CFO pushed back on the original Q4 marketing budget, leading to a revised proposal eight percent lower. They have weekly meetings with the CMO and a decent working relationship. They are aware the offsite agenda includes the campaign as a topic.

Ostara Foods has a leadership offsite scheduled for September 21, 2026. The offsite agenda already lists the campaign as a topic. The marketing team's revised Q4 budget is eight percent below the original ask. The CFO and CMO meet weekly and work together decently.
